subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel Dashboard prune flow for orphaned Telegram/Discord sessions, and if so what reachability, retention, and auto-prune policy should it use?
rationale: The remaining work is destructive session-state cleanup across plugin-owned reachability and user history retention; source inspection shows no narrow bug patch can safely choose those policies automatically.

options.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
options.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks and apply deletion only after revalidation and explicit user confirmation.

options.title: Narrow Discord-only cleanup
options.body: Handle Discord thread/channel orphan cleanup through the narrower open Discord issue first and defer the cross-channel Dashboard UX.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Keep selected-row deletion and CLI cleanup as the supported paths, and close this feature direction as too risky for core now.

recommendation.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
recommendation.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks and apply deletion only after revalidation and explicit user confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-maintenance policy history makes steipete the strongest routing owner for the destructive cleanup policy decision.
